subject: Retention handoff & operational playbook for backup purge and log exceptions
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Health Legal <legal@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Align on backup purge & log retention exceptions (DPA amendment)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call last week. Our legal team circulated an updated DPA amendment this morning requesting clarifications on three things that will impact our data lifecycle plan:

- The purge timeline for backups (they want explicit windows and rollback safeguards).
- What categories of logs will be considered "retention-exempt" for fraud/forensics and for how long.
- Evidence we can provide after a purge (runbook, job IDs, screenshots).

We attached DPA_Amendment_v2.pdf with their redlines. Compliance is hoping to schedule the production purge/hand-off the week of July 18–22; they want a short mutual action plan and a list of subprocessors that will touch backups during the operation.

Can you put together a short MAP and confirm whether Redwood can provide per-job attestations (screenshot + job id + S3 manifest) and whether there are any known subprocessor retention carveouts?

Olivia
Director, Compliance Operations
Acme Health

Attachment: DPA_Amendment_v2.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-01T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Align on backup purge & log retention exceptions (DPA amendment)

Olivia — thanks, got the redlines. Looping in Lauren and Marissa (infra + ops) and Jonas (security) to draft a mutual action plan and confirm technical evidence we can provide.

Quick proposal from my side (we'll formalize in the MAP):

1) Scope: backups in S3 (snapshots + object-store backups) + short-term streaming logs (7 days) + audit logs (config + auth events).
2) Canary purge: July 20 02:00 UTC — single region (us-west-2) on 1% of prefixes. Produce manifest and job id.
3) Full purge wave 1: July 21 02:00 UTC — non-critical prefixes (dev/staging).
4) Full purge wave 2: July 22 04:00 UTC — production prefixes with rollback snapshot pinned for 48 hours.
5) Exceptions: audit & forensics logs will be retained to 90 days by default; any longer holds require a legal hold request and escalation path.

Ask to Acme: please confirm which business units need longer audit retention and whether any active investigations require pause of canonical purge windows.

I'll attach a MAP draft (MAP-draft.md) and the initial purge schedule CSV. We can iterate.

Karthik
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-draft.md, purge-schedule-v1.csv

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Align on backup purge & log retention exceptions (DPA amendment)

Hi all — adding operational detail and the runbook link so legal and infra have concrete evidence artifacts. Key points below:

Operational playbook (high-level)
- Pre-check (T-minus 72h): inventory snapshot verification, subprocessor contact list (we flag any third-party snapshot services), and access audit reviewed.
- Canary (T=0): single-region purge job with logging enabled and job id returned. We will capture: job id, S3 manifest (list of object keys deleted), CloudTrail entries (for deletion API calls), and a screen capture of the job summary.
- Rollout (T+24/48h): staggered waves by prefix/tenant, with automatic abort on >0.5% error rate or >200ms API errors.

Log retention carveouts
- Ephemeral request logs (search index requests, short-lived debug logs): purge immediately with the backups.
- Audit/config/auth events: retain 90 days by default. These are considered retention-exempt without a legal hold request.
- Fraud/forensics: can request up to 1 year, but needs legal request + escalation (we will surface cost/operational impact).

Evidence we can provide post-purge
- S3 manifest CSV (s3_purge_manifest.csv)
- Job ID and CloudTrail trace links
- Runbook link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-runbooks (read-only share for Acme)
- Signed attestation (DocuSign) if required by procurement

Notes/constraints: any archived cold-storage snapshots that live with our subprocessor XBackups Inc. may need a separate purge step and longer lead time (we estimate 4–6 weeks to coordinate). Please confirm if Acme holds data in any cold-archive tiers.

I'll update the MAP with these bullets and add the exact runbook steps.

Thanks,
Lauren
VP, Infrastructure Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: purge-schedule-v1.csv

From: Acme Health Legal <legal@acmehealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-03T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Align on backup purge & log retention exceptions (DPA amendment)

Lauren/Karthik — thanks for the clear plan. A few follow-ups from legal: 

1) Acme will accept the 90-day default for audit logs but requests a documented exception process for fraud investigations (template language included in the attached redline).
2) For the canary and full purge we require: a) a signed attestation (DocuSign) confirming deletion, b) the S3 manifest CSV, and c) CloudTrail job trace URLs.

We will start the DocuSign flow once Redwood confirms who will be the signee for attestations (title and email). Also confirm whether subprocessor XBackups Inc. is in-scope and provide contact. If XBackups will host cold snapshots, we need an explicit timeline for that purge.

Regards,
Acme Health Legal (on behalf of Olivia Grant)

Attachment: Acme_DPA_Redline-comments.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Acme Health Legal <legal@acmehealth.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-05T14:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Align on backup purge & log retention exceptions (DPA amendment)

Thanks — we can meet all of the asks. Quick confirmations: 

- Signee for attestations: Priya Natarajan, Head of Trust & Compliance 
  Email: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
- XBackups Inc. is a third-party subprocessor for cold-tier snapshots — contact: ops@xbackups.example (we will coordinate purge; estimated timeline 4 weeks).
- DocuSign flow: we will kick off the DocuSign after you confirm the final DPA redline; otherwise we can start with a standing attestation template.
- Canary is scheduled: July 20 02:00 UTC (us-west-2). We will provide the S3 manifest and CloudTrail traces within 4 hours of completion and a signed attestation within 24 hours.

Next steps:
- Karthik to share MAP-draft link (updated) and the read-only runbook.
- Acme to confirm any business-unit exceptions by July 10 EOD.
- Redwood to open a coordination channel (we'll create a shared Slack channel and a short incident-style timeline in the runbook).

I'll attach the s3_purge_manifest.csv after the canary run.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Karthik
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment (post-canary): s3_purge_manifest.csv
